sources.sourceScope: Shared slice position lookup through Vec dereference
sources.semantics: Position lookup returns a borrowed element when in bounds and None otherwise. Range indexing is outside this adapter.
An empty slice returns None; a nonempty slice returns its borrowed first element.
An empty slice returns None; a nonempty slice returns its borrowed final element.

portableProfile.elementRepresentation: actual checked primitive, array or algebraic layout
portableProfile.returnRepresentation: monomorphic Option carrying the original element

validation: Node and Bun tests use actual checker-resolved recursive serde_json layouts, primitive domains, records, independent boundary expectations and typed failure fixtures.
limitations: Frontend registration and receiver/borrow proofs are required before a source call becomes executable translation.
Mutation, interior mutability, ownership transfer, iterator behavior, ranges and unchecked indexing are not implemented.
No Rust execution or whole-program parity claim is made.
